title: Grilled Chicken Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice.
Season and cook the chicken.
Serve together.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Boil spaghetti.
Cook beef.
Add sauce and combine.

title: Vegetable Omelette
steps: Beat eggs.
Cook vegetables.
Add eggs and cook.

title: Overnight Oats with Berries
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, honey, and vanilla in a jar until combined.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours until thick.
Top with berries and add a splash of milk if you want a looser texture.

title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Stir the honey into the yogurt.
Layer yogurt, strawberries, and granola in a glass or bowl.
Top with nuts and serve right away to keep the granola crunchy.

title: Scrambled Eggs with Spinach and Tomato
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a pan, wilt spinach for 30-60 seconds, then pour in the eggs.
Stir gently until softly set, then fold in the tomato and serve.

title: Banana Oat Smoothie
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth, scraping down the sides if needed.
Adjust thickness with a little more milk or ice, then serve.

title: Classic Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt; whisk egg, milk, and oil separately, then combine just until mixed.
Melt a little butter in a pan over medium heat and pour small rounds of batter.
Flip when bubbles form and edges look set, then cook until lightly golden.

title: Veggie Omelet with Cheese
steps: Saute mushrooms and bell pepper in olive oil until tender, then push to one side of the pan.
Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper, then pour into the pan and cook until mostly set.
Add cheese and veggies, fold the omelet, and cook 30 seconds more before serving.

title: Avocado Toast with Fried Egg
steps: Toast the bread and mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Fry eggs in olive oil to your preferred doneness.
Spread avocado on toast and top each slice with an egg.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread if you like it warm and crisp.
Spread peanut butter evenly over each slice.
Top with banana slices and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Breakfast Burritos with Beans and Cheese
steps: Scramble eggs with salt; warm beans and rice until hot.
Fill tortillas with eggs, beans, rice, salsa, and cheese, then roll tightly.
Optional: sear burritos seam-side down in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes to crisp.

title: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
steps: Simmer oats, water, apple, and salt in a small pot, stirring often.
Cook until the oats are tender and the mixture thickens, 3-5 minutes.
Stir in brown sugar and cinnamon, then top with walnuts.

title: Chicken Salad Sandwich
steps: Mix chicken, mayonnaise, celery, onion, lemon juice, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Spoon onto bread, close sandwiches, and slice to serve.

title: Tuna Salad Lettuce Wraps
steps: Stir tuna with mayonnaise, mustard, celery, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spoon the mixture into lettuce leaves.
Fold and eat like wraps, or serve open as cups.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Saute onion in olive oil until soft, then add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, broth, basil, salt, and pepper; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then reheat briefly and serve.

title: Lentil Vegetable Soup
steps: Cook onion, carrots, and celery in olive oil until softened; add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add lentils, tomatoes, broth, and salt; simmer until lentils are tender, 25-35 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Hummus and Veggie Pita
steps: Cut pitas open or split them to make pockets.
Spread hummus inside and add vegetables and feta.
Close, slice in half, and serve.

title: Cheesy Bean Quesadillas
steps: Lightly mash beans with cumin and salt.
Fill tortillas with beans and cheese, fold, and toast in a lightly oiled pan until golden on both sides.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
steps: Combine chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano, then pour over and toss.
Chill 15 minutes for best flavor, then serve.

title: Turkey and Cheese Wrap
steps: Spread mustard on tortillas.
Layer turkey, cheese, lettuce, and tomato.
Roll tightly and slice in half to serve.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Cook onion and carrot in oil until tender; add garlic for 30 seconds, then stir in peas.
Push veggies aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix everything together.
Add rice, soy sauce, and sesame oil; stir-fry until hot and evenly seasoned.

title: Veggie Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta until tender, drain, and cool under cold water.
Toss pasta with vegetables, feta, olive oil, vinegar, and salt.
Chill before serving for best texture and flavor.

title: Baked Lemon Garlic Salmon
steps: Place salmon on a baking sheet, season with salt and pepper, and add lemon slices on top.
Melt butter with garlic and olive oil, then spoon over the salmon.
Bake at 200C until flaky, about 10-14 minutes depending on thickness.

title: Quick Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Mix soy sauce, honey, and cornstarch to make a quick sauce.
Stir-fry chicken in oil until mostly cooked, then add vegetables and cook until crisp-tender.
Pour in sauce and cook 1-2 minutes until glossy and thickened.

title: Ground Beef Tacos
steps: Cook beef and onion until browned; drain excess fat if needed.
Add taco seasoning and water; simmer 3-5 minutes until thickened.
Fill shells with meat and top with lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.

title: Turkey Chili
steps: Saute onion and bell pepper in olive oil; add garlic for 30 seconds.
Brown turkey, then add chili powder, cumin, tomatoes, beans, and salt.
Simmer 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and flavorful.

title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
steps: Cook onion in oil until soft; add garlic and curry powder and stir 30-60 seconds.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, and salt; simmer 10-15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted and serve over rice.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss chicken and vegetables with olive oil, spices, and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast at 220C, stirring once, until chicken is cooked and edges char slightly.
Warm tortillas and serve fajita filling with your preferred toppings.

title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch, water, and sesame oil into a sauce.
Sear beef in oil, then remove; stir-fry broccoli until bright and crisp-tender, adding garlic near the end.
Return beef, pour in sauce, and cook 1-2 minutes until thickened.

title: Baked Chicken Thighs and Potatoes
steps: Toss potatoes with olive oil, half the salt, and seasonings; spread on a sheet pan.
Season chicken with remaining salt and pepper and place among potatoes.
Bake at 220C until chicken is cooked and potatoes are tender, about 35-45 minutes.

title: Black Bean Burgers
steps: Mash beans until mostly crushed, then mix with breadcrumbs, egg, onion, garlic, spices, and ketchup.
Form into patties and chill 10 minutes so they hold together better.
Pan-fry in olive oil until browned on both sides and heated through.

title: Crispy Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Toss tofu with cornstarch; fry in oil until crisp, then set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables until crisp-tender; add garlic near the end.
Return tofu and add soy sauce and brown sugar; toss until glazed and hot.

title: Shrimp Rice Bowls with Crunchy Veggies
steps: Stir soy sauce, lime juice, and honey to make a quick dressing.
Saute shrimp in oil until pink and cooked through, 2-4 minutes.
Build bowls with rice, vegetables, shrimp, and drizzle with dressing.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
steps: Cook noodles until flexible; mix ricotta with egg, salt, and spinach.
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta mixture, vegetables, and mozzarella in a baking dish.
Bake at 190C until bubbly and browned on top, then rest 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Cook onion, carrots, and celery in olive oil until softened; add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add broth and salt, bring to a simmer, then cook noodles until tender.
Stir in chicken and heat through before serving.

title: Minestrone Soup
steps: Saute onion, carrots, and celery in olive oil until softened; add garlic briefly.
Add tomatoes, broth, beans, pasta, and salt; simmer until pasta is tender.
Rest 5 minutes, then serve.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
steps: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, vinegar, ginger, and cornstarch to make a sauce.
Cook chicken until browned and cooked through; steam or microwave broccoli and carrot until tender-crisp.
Add sauce to chicken and simmer briefly to thicken, then serve over rice with vegetables.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Cut tops off peppers and remove seeds; bake empty peppers at 190C for 10 minutes to soften.
Cook beef with onion and garlic, then stir in rice, tomato sauce, oregano, and salt.
Stuff peppers, top with cheese, and bake until hot and melted, about 15-20 minutes.

title: Pesto Pasta with Tomatoes
steps: Cook pasta until tender and reserve a splash of cooking water, then drain.
Toss pasta with pesto and a little cooking water to loosen into a sauce.
Fold in tomatoes, spinach, parmesan, and salt; serve once spinach wilts.

title: Sausage and Peppers Skillet
steps: Brown sausage in a skillet, then remove and slice; add olive oil if the pan is dry.
Cook onion and peppers until softened; add garlic briefly.
Return sausage, add tomatoes, oregano, and salt, and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry Noodles
steps: Cook noodles, drain, and set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables in oil until crisp-tender; add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add noodles, soy sauce, brown sugar, and vinegar; toss until glossy and hot.

title: Classic Guacamole
steps: Mash avocados in a bowl until mostly smooth with some texture.
Stir in onion, garlic, lime juice, salt, cilantro, jalapeno, and tomato.
Taste and adjust salt or lime, then serve immediately.

title: Roasted Spiced Chickpeas
steps: Pat chickpeas very dry, then toss with olive oil and spices.
Roast at 220C until crisp, shaking the pan once, about 20-30 minutes.
Cool completely to maximize crunch, then store in a container.

title: Simple Trail Mix
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Mix well and portion into small containers or bags.
Store at room temperature for quick snacks.

title: Honey-Lime Fruit Salad
steps: Add fruit to a bowl.
Whisk honey, lime juice, and zest, then pour over fruit and toss gently.
Top with mint and chill 10-15 minutes before serving.

title: No-Bake Energy Bites
steps: Mix oats, peanut butter, honey, chia seeds, chocolate chips, and vanilla until thick.
Chill 15 minutes so the mixture firms up.
Roll into small balls and store refrigerated.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugars, then mix in egg and vanilla until smooth.
Stir in flour, baking soda, and salt, then fold in chocolate chips.
Bake spoonfuls at 180C until edges set, about 10-12 minutes.

title: Classic Banana Bread
steps: Mix mashed bananas with melted butter, sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
Fold in flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon until just combined.
Bake at 175C until a tester comes out clean, about 50-65 minutes.

title: Apple Crisp
steps: Toss apples with lemon juice, sugar, and cinnamon, then spread in a baking dish.
Rub butter into oats, flour, brown sugar, and salt until crumbly; sprinkle over apples.
Bake at 190C until bubbling and golden, about 35-45 minutes.

title: Easy Cocoa Brownies
steps: Melt butter and whisk in sugar, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Stir in cocoa powder, flour, and salt until just combined.
Bake at 175C until set but still fudgy in the center, about 20-25 minutes.

title: Creamy Rice Pudding
steps: Simmer rice, milk, and salt over low heat, stirring often so it doesn't stick.
Cook until rice is tender and the pudding is creamy, 30-45 minutes.
Stir in sugar, vanilla, and cinnamon, then serve warm or chilled.
